units.source_text: 紫夫人生前亲信的几个侍女，都哭得不省人事。

en.t: The few maidservants whom Lady Murasaki had trusted in life all wept until they lost consciousness.

units.source_text: 源氏虽然也悲伤得神志昏迷，只得勉强镇静下来，料理丧葬一切事宜。

en.t: Genji too was so overcome with grief that his senses were clouded, but he had no choice but to force himself to be calm and attend to every matter of the funeral.

units.source_text: 此种可悲之事，他从前曾经遭逢过好几次，然而从来没有尝过如此痛切的苦味。

en.t: He had encountered such sorrowful events several times before, yet he had never tasted a bitterness so piercing.

units.source_text: 此度伤心，竟是过去所无，未来所不会有的。

en.t: This grief was something he had never known in the past and would never know again in the future.

units.source_text: 葬仪就在当日举行。

en.t: The funeral rites were held that very day.

units.source_text: 虽然恋恋不舍，但此事限定时日，

en.t: Although no one could bear to part from her, such matters are bound to a fixed time,

units.source_text: 终不能永久守着遗体度日，真乃人世可悲之事。

en.t: and one cannot spend day after day forever guarding the remains; it is truly one of the sorrows of human life.

units.source_text: 广大无边的火葬场上，挤满了送葬人。

en.t: The vast cremation ground was crowded with mourners.

units.source_text: 葬仪之隆重无以复加。

en.t: The solemn splendor of the funeral could not have been greater.

units.source_text: 然而遗体化作一片烟云，立刻升入天空。

en.t: Yet the body turned into a cloud of smoke and immediately rose into the sky.

units.source_text: 虽是当然之事，实在令人痛心。

en.t: Though this was only natural, it was truly heartbreaking.

units.source_text: 源氏悲伤得如醉如梦，靠在人肩上来到葬地。

en.t: Genji, grief-stricken as if drunk or dreaming, came to the burial ground leaning on another person's shoulder.

units.source_text: 见者无不感动，连那些无知无识的愚民，也都洒下同情之泪，

en.t: Everyone who saw him was moved, and even the ignorant common people shed tears of sympathy,

units.source_text: 他们说：“如此身份高贵之人，也难免除此恨！”

en.t: saying, "Even a person of such noble rank cannot escape this sorrow."

units.source_text: 何况来送葬的侍女，个个心迷意乱，似觉身在梦中，

en.t: How much more so the maidservants who had come for the funeral procession: every one of them was distraught, as if she were in a dream,

units.source_text: 几乎从车上翻落下来，亏得车副照料。

en.t: and they nearly tumbled from their carriages, saved only by the attendants who looked after them.

units.source_text: 源氏回想昔年夕雾的母亲葵夫人逝世那天早晨，

en.t: Genji thought back to the morning long ago when Lady Aoi, Yugiri's mother, had died.

units.source_text: 虽然也很悲伤，还不失去知觉，记得那时月色甚明，

en.t: He had been deeply saddened then too, but he had not lost consciousness, and he still remembered how bright the moonlight had been.

units.source_text: 但今宵只有以泪洗面，一切都不知了。

en.t: But tonight he could only wash his face with tears and was aware of nothing at all.

units.source_text: 紫夫人是十四日亡故的，葬仪于十五日早晨举行。

en.t: Lady Murasaki died on the fourteenth, and the funeral was held on the morning of the fifteenth.

units.source_text: 不久太阳鲜艳地升入天空，原野上的朝露消散得影迹全无。

en.t: Before long the sun rose brilliantly into the sky, and the morning dew on the fields vanished without a trace.

units.source_text: 源氏痛感人世无常，正如此露，越发厌世悲观起来。

en.t: Genji felt keenly that human life is as transient as that dew, and he grew still more weary of the world and despondent.

units.source_text: 心念今后独留在世，为日无多，不如乘此机会，成遂了出家夙愿。

en.t: He thought that if he remained alone in the world from now on, his days would not be many, and that he should take this chance to fulfill his long-cherished wish to become a monk.

units.source_text: 但恐后人讥笑他感情脆弱，只得且过几时再说。

en.t: But fearing that later people would mock him as emotionally weak, he could only decide to let some time pass first.

units.source_text: 然而胸中郁结，不堪其苦。

en.t: Yet the anguish knotted in his heart, and he could not bear the pain.
